arabic text: LAGEGI AAG, JAL JAAYENGE KHAYMEIN BHI, QANAATEIN BHI\nBANANA KHAAK KO BISTAR,\nSAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
english translation text: THERE WILL BE FIRE IN THE TENTS AND ALL\nWILL BE BURNT THE DUST OF KARBALA WILL\nBE YOUR BED, SAKINA I WILL NOT BE THERE.

arabic text:
MERE SEENE, PE SONEY KE BAJAAYE,
DEKHO SO JAANA
PHUPI AMMA KE ZAANU PAR,
SAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
english translation text:
INSTEAD OF SLEEPING ON MY CHEST,
YOU MUST SLEEP ON THE
CHEST OF YOUR AUNT ZAINAB, SAKINA
I WILL NOT BE THERE

arabic text: BASADARMA, JO MAINE DONON KAANON ME PINHAYE THEY\nCHINENGE JAB AAH GAUHAR,\nSAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
english translation text: THOSE EARRING WHICH I PUT IN YOUR EAR WITH\nA GREAT LOVE AND WISHES WHEN THOSE EARRING WILL\nBE PULLED OFF, SAKINA I WILL NOT BE THERE.

arabic text:
LAHU KAANON SE BARSEGA,
SAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
TAMAACHEY RUKH PAY BARSENGE
PHIRAYI JAOGI DAR DAR,
english translation text:
THERE WILL BE BLOOD FORM YOUR EARS
AND YOU WILL BE SLAPPED ON FACE.
YOU WILL BE TAKEN AS CAPTIVE AND MOVED
AROUND, SAKINA I WILL NOT BE THERE.

arabic text: TUMHARI MAA PHUPHI BEHNON KE SAR SE,\nAAH CHEENEY GAYE KOI MAQNA, KOI CHAADAR,\nSAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
english translation text: LOOTER WILL LOOT THE BELONGING FOR\nYOUR AUNTS AND SISTERS WEILL AND\nCOVERINGS, SAKINA I WILL NOT BE THERE.

arabic text: KABHI NAQEY SE, GIR JAOGI RASTEY ME,\nTO GODI ME UTHALEGI MERI MAADAR,\nSAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
english translation text: ONCE YOU WILL FALL FORM THE BACK OF THE\nCAMEL DURING THE JOURNEY. YOU WILL BE PICKED UP BY\nMY MOTHER FATIMA, SAKINA I WILL NOT BE THERE.

arabic text:
YEH KEHTE THE, SHAH-E-MUZTAR,
SAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
WO WAQT AAYEGA, AB TUMPAR,
SAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
english translation text:
THIS WAS THE SAYING OF IMAM HUSSAIN,
SAKINA,
I WILL NOT BE THERE THAT TIME WILL COME SOON,
I WILL NOT BE THERE.
